acceptance_criteria: Every declared fault appears exactly once with its resolved target, fault class, simulation trigger, duration, and typed parameters.
Equal declared schedules compile to an equal ordered schedule; competing schedule ambiguity is rejected.
No fault is activated or cleared and no fault runtime is invoked.
applicability: Phase 1 XDL Lite bounded software allocation (offline declared experiment intent compilation). status 'accepted' records internal engineering intent only; it is not implementation satisfaction or external delivery acceptance.
statement: The compiler shall compile the declared intended fault schedule - fault identity, resolved target, fault class, simulation trigger, duration, and typed parameters - into a deterministic order with a stable tie-break, and shall not activate, inject, clear, or otherwise execute any fault.
title: Deterministic intended fault schedule
verification_intent: Planned to be exercised through the XDL1-UNIT, XDL1-STATIC, XDL1-INTEGRATION, and XDL1-VALIDATION measures defined in the XDL1 verification-design stage, invoking the real loader, schema registry, catalog, activation-plan consumer, and additive CLI/API. No runtime, availability, compatibility, or readiness claim is made.
